# Command line examples

<!-- Generated by `just docs-cli-examples` from the bundled simulators; do not edit. -->

Every command of [`mdbrowser`](cli.md) run against the [test servers](simulators.md) (`just all`), with
the output it printed. Long output is shortened (`…`). Live values and timestamps differ on every run.

## Endpoints of an OPC UA server

Security modes, policies and logins, most secure first.

```sh
mdbrowser endpoints opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:50000
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
url                         mode            policy                 level  logins                          thumbprint
opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:50000/  SignAndEncrypt  Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss   110    Anonymous UserName Certificate  36DEFBDCBFB40A8C205786ABC4A0BCB025BDA051
opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:50000/  SignAndEncrypt  Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep  108    Anonymous UserName Certificate  36DEFBDCBFB40A8C205786ABC4A0BCB025BDA051
```

## Browse OPC UA

One level below a node; paths can be passed to `read` and `monitor` as they are.

```sh
mdbrowser browse opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:4841 /Objects/Custom
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
path                             class     id
/Objects/Custom/Machines         Object    ns=2;i=19
/Objects/Custom/Structures       Object    ns=2;i=35
/Objects/Custom/DataTypes        Object    ns=2;i=44
/Objects/Custom/Fast             Object    ns=2;i=74
/Objects/Custom/EdgeCases        Object    ns=2;i=93
/Objects/Custom/Methods          Object    ns=2;i=132
/Objects/Custom/Large            Object    ns=2;i=142
/Objects/Custom/Flat             Object    ns=2;i=253
/Objects/Custom/History          Object    ns=2;i=254
/Objects/Custom/PauseSimulation  Variable  ns=2;s=PauseSimulation
```

## Browse S7 with a tag list

`--map` gives the tree the symbol table's names (here the simulator's `tags.csv`, a TIA Portal CSV export).

```sh
mdbrowser browse s7://127.0.0.1/0,1 --map tags.csv /Tags/Machine
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
path                       class     id
/Tags/Machine/Running      Variable  "Machine.Running"
/Tags/Machine/Fault        Variable  "Machine.Fault"
/Tags/Machine/Blink        Variable  "Machine.Blink"
/Tags/Machine/Speed        Variable  "Machine.Speed"
/Tags/Machine/Counter      Variable  "Machine.Counter"
/Tags/Machine/Temperature  Variable  "Machine.Temperature"
/Tags/Machine/Pressure     Variable  "Machine.Pressure"
/Tags/Machine/Mode         Variable  "Machine.Mode"
/Tags/Machine/Status       Variable  "Machine.Status"
/Tags/Machine/Name         Variable  "Machine.Name"
/Tags/Machine/Setpoint     Variable  "Machine.Setpoint"
/Tags/Machine/Recipe       Variable  "Machine.Recipe"
/Tags/Machine/Runtime      Variable  "Machine.Runtime"
```

## Read S7 addresses

Without a tag list: absolute addresses with an optional type.

```sh
mdbrowser read s7://127.0.0.1/0,1 DB1.DBD2:REAL MW2:INT DB3.DBB28:STRING[10] DB2.DBW40:INT[10]
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
name                  type    value
DB1.DBD2:REAL         Float   1307.5247
MW2:INT               Int16   1474
DB3.DBB28:STRING[10]  String  Hello
DB2.DBW40:INT[10]     INT[]   [1474, 2948, 4422, 5896, 7370, 8844, 10318, 11792, 13266, 14740]
```

## Read values

Value and data type of one or more variables.

```sh
mdbrowser read opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:4841 /Objects/Custom/DataTypes/Int32 /Objects/Custom/DataTypes/Double /Objects/Custom/DataTypes/String
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
name    type    value
Int32   Int32   -123456
Double  Double  2.718281828459045
String  String  Hello OPC UA
```

## Read an MQTT topic with a JSON payload

The whole payload of the topic, as received.

```sh
mdbrowser read mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883 /Topics/machines/m1/status
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
name    type    value
status  String  {"state":"Stop","speed":1498.44,"temperature":{"bearing":54.22,"motor":60.68},"alarms":[],"ok":true,"operator":null}
```

## Read properties from the JSON on a topic

Each property of a JSON payload is a node below its topic, nested objects too; it is read with its own type.

```sh
mdbrowser read mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883 /Topics/machines/m1/status/speed /Topics/machines/m1/status/state /Topics/machines/m1/status/temperature/motor
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
name   type    value
speed  Double  1408.95
state  String  Idle
motor  Double  60.03
```

## Read a JSON property by its id

`topic#/path` is the same property as the id the app and `browse` show.

```sh
mdbrowser read mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883 "t:machines/m1/status#/temperature/bearing"
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
name                                       type    value
t:machines/m1/status#/temperature/bearing  Double  54.13
```

## Monitor live values

Every 500 ms for 2 seconds (or until Ctrl+C without `--duration`).

```sh
mdbrowser monitor opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:4841 /Objects/Custom/Fast/Every10ms/Counter /Objects/Custom/Fast/Every10ms/Sine -r 500 --duration 2s
```

``` { .text .no-copy }

23:48:48.733  Counter                      Good         5300
23:48:48.733  Sine                         Good         0.020292924781080683
```

## Monitor Sparkplug B metrics

Sparkplug B metrics by their id, `m:group|edge node|device|metric`. Births name the metrics; until the next birth (this simulator re-sends them every 15 s, a real edge node on start and on a rebirth request) values arrive under their alias, so ids by name are the reliable way from the command line.

```sh
mdbrowser monitor mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883 "m:Plant1|Edge1|Press1|Temperature" "m:Plant1|Edge1|Press1|Pressure" -r 1000 --duration 20s
```


## Write a value

Shows the value before and after; without `--yes` it asks first.

```sh
mdbrowser write opc.tcp://127.0.0.1:4841 /Objects/Custom/DataTypes/Int16 -321 --yes
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
name   before  after  result
Int16  -1234   -321   written
```

## Create a session for the app

```sh
mdbrowser session create press1.mdbsession mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883 /Topics/plant/hall1/press1/temperature /Topics/plant/hall1/press1/pressure
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
Saved 2 watch item(s) to press1.mdbsession (mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883).
```

## Add to a session

```sh
mdbrowser session add press1.mdbsession /Topics/plant/hall1/press1/state /Topics/plant/hall1/press2/temperature
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
Added 2 watch item(s) to press1.mdbsession; 4 in total.
```

## Remove from a session

Offline: the file is changed without connecting.

```sh
mdbrowser session remove press1.mdbsession /Topics/plant/hall1/press2/temperature
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
Removed 1 watch item(s) from press1.mdbsession; 3 left.
```

## Run a session

Its watch list, each item at its refresh time.

```sh
mdbrowser run press1.mdbsession --duration 2s
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
```

## An S7 session with its tag list

The tag list is saved in the session (relative to it) and used by `run`.

```sh
mdbrowser session create line1.mdbsession s7://127.0.0.1/0,1 --map tags.csv /Tags/Machine/Speed /Tags/Machine/Counter
```

``` { .text .no-copy }
Saved 2 watch item(s) to line1.mdbsession (s7://127.0.0.1/0,1).
```

```sh
mdbrowser run line1.mdbsession --duration 2s
```
